id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

The data settings for this component.

filterComponent.description:
A single search component serves as a filter
Note: Use a componentRef to make this filter connect to backend and make API calls
Only define a `UiSdlSingleSearch` will just get the UI component, no API connect to it. It is just for backward compatibility.

filterValue.description: Interval field to set the value of the filter
